ValidationRule.description: Prevents users from using the Modification Requested or the Completed status for uAssist Orders. Onlly admins/Boomi can use this status/
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL( uAssist_Status__c , "Modification Requested"), ISPICKVAL( uAssist_Status__c , "Completed") ), NOT( OR( $Profile.Name = "System Administrator", $Profile.Name = "uLab SysAdmin" ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Modification Requested and Completed can only be assigned by Integration.
